# v0.3.0 — Fixed & Rebuilt on Ollama's Current API

> **⚡ Fixes broken usage tracking.** Ollama retired the old usage endpoint, which left v0.2.x unable to fetch any data. This release switches to Ollama's current, documented API — update to v0.3.0 and tracking works again.

## What's New

- **Requests 24h / Requests 7d** — rolling request counts for the last 24 hours and 7 days, with the current hour's count as an attribute.
- **Purchased Balance** — your pay-as-you-go credit balance in USD.
- **Credits-plan sensors** — if your account uses the credits plan, you also get **Included Balance**, **Included Allowance**, and **Included Resets At**. (Legacy-plan accounts won't see these.)
- **Opt-in watchdog** — a new `enable_watchdog` option (off by default) flags when the server's remaining-percentage jumps unexpectedly.

## Improvements

- **Accurate reset times** — "Resets At" sensors now show the reset time exactly as Ollama's server reports it, instead of an estimated schedule.
- **Clearer errors** — a suspended or under-scoped account now shows a distinct "account suspended" message instead of a misleading re-auth prompt.
- **Rate-limit friendly** — when Ollama asks the integration to slow down, it now waits exactly as long as the server requests.

## Removed

- **Activity Cost** and **per-model request** sensors — Ollama's current API no longer provides this data. Their leftover registry entries are cleaned up automatically when you upgrade; no manual cleanup needed.
- The optional "verify data" step during setup — obsolete now that reset times come straight from the server.

## Upgrading from v0.2.x

Update via HACS and restart Home Assistant. The removed sensors disappear on their own — no action required. If you had automations referencing Activity Cost or per-model request sensors, remove or update those references.
